Subject: CarePath impact profile — 30-min discovery interview (recording/consent)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with us. We'd love to capture a short (30 minute) discovery interview to build a brief impact profile we can share as a customer story. The goal is to surface quantitative outcomes and a couple of short quotes about how CarePath uses Redwood Inference in production.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- 5m quick intros and context
- 10m outcomes & metrics (latency/cost improvements, user-facing impact)
- 10m implementation highlights (rollout, caching/quantization choices)
- 5m usage quote & next steps

Could you confirm the right stakeholders from your side (who should join besides you)? We can run the call as a recording for internal note-taking and for potential short excerpts in a case write-up or website quote if you give consent — we will share the draft before anything is published.

Availability (PST) — pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite:
- Mon 11/30 09:30–10:00
- Mon 11/30 11:00–11:30
- Tue 12/1 14:00–14:30

I’ve attached a short questionnaire (high level) we can fill live or you can send answers if preferred.

Attachments: CarePath-case-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — look forward to it.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
